section.content: Provide electronic installation, wherein can the running voltage of built-in semiconductor integrated circuit be suppressed low. Electronic installation (1) includes power circuit (13), the temperature sensor (11) of temperature with the semiconductor integrated circuit (10) of supply voltage work provided from power circuit (13) and measurement semiconductor integrated circuit (10). Power circuit (13) reduces supply voltage corresponding to the rising of measured temperature.
提供了电子装置，其中可以将内置的半导体集成电路的工作电压抑制得低。电子装置（1）包括电源电路（13）、以从电源电路（13）提供的电源电压工作的半导体集成电路（10）和测量半导体集成电路（10）的温度的温度传感器（11）。电源电路（13）对应于所测量的温度的上升降低电源电压。

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to the semiconductor integrated circuit being incorporated to CMOS and the electronic installation including this semiconductor integrated circuit.

Background technology

Including the semiconductor integrated circuit of CMOS, such as CPU (CPU) and SOC(system level chip) it is widely used as the assembly (referring to such as patent documentation 1) in electronic installation.

Prior art document

Patent document:

Patent document 1: the description that U.S. Patent No. 6518823

Summary of the invention

In recent years, along with the microminiaturization of CMOS, the tendency being different from conventional products shows in the temperature dependency of its performance. But, the method being efficiently used semiconductor integrated circuit according to this characteristic is not taken into full account.

Further, generally, this semiconductor integrated circuit is operated in constant operating frequency. But, according to different situations, as this semiconductor integrated circuit carries out contents processing, it is often unnecessary for being operated in so high operating frequency. Additionally, continuous firing can increase the power consumption of semiconductor integrated circuit in altofrequency. Therefore, the semiconductor integrated circuit of the operating frequency that can dynamically change its own according to different situations is occurred in that. This semiconductor integrated circuit is according to circumstances operated in high workload frequency. But, in time being operated in altofrequency and be unnecessary, it is possible to suppress power consumption by reducing operating frequency. When semiconductor integrated circuit changes operating frequency, owing to noise current can fluctuate. Here, provided that have just close to the value of the lower voltage limit as the required minimum voltage that works after operating frequency change to the supply voltage of semiconductor integrated circuit, so owing to this current fluctuation causes temporary voltage to reduce, the running voltage of semiconductor integrated circuit may drop below this lower voltage limit. Therefore, when operating frequency changes, it is necessary to provide the lower voltage limit of the required minimum voltage that works after being used for operating frequency change at least to exceed the voltage being likely to be due to the falling quantity of voltages that noise causes to semiconductor integrated circuit.

In view of above-mentioned practical situation devises the present invention, an object of the present invention is to provide running voltage can be suppressed to the semiconductor integrated circuit of low-voltage, the electronic installation including this semiconductor integrated circuit and control method thereof.

The semiconductor integrated circuit of low-voltage, its control method can be suppressed to additionally, it is a further object of the present invention to provide the supply voltage being provided to semiconductor integrated circuit when operating frequency changes and include the electronic installation of this semiconductor integrated circuit.

Electronic installation according to an aspect of the present invention includes power circuit, by the semiconductor integrated circuit of supply voltage work provided from power circuit and the temperature sensor of temperature measuring semiconductor integrated circuit, it is characterized in that, power circuit reduces supply voltage according to the rising of measured temperature.

In addition, the control method of electronic installation according to an aspect of the present invention is the control method of a kind of electronic installation, this electronic installation includes: power circuit, the semiconductor integrated circuit of the supply voltage work provided by power circuit and measure the temperature sensor of temperature of semiconductor integrated circuit, this control method is characterised by, including obtaining the step of measured temperature and reducing the step of the supply voltage that power circuit is supplied to semiconductor integrated circuit according to rising of measured temperature.

In addition, semiconductor integrated circuit according to a further aspect in the invention is the semiconductor integrated circuit of the supply voltage work by providing from power circuit, this semiconductor integrated circuit is characterised by, including the temperature sensor of the temperature measuring semiconductor integrated circuit, and request power circuit reduces the requested part of supply voltage according to rising of measured temperature.

In addition, semiconductor integrated circuit according to a further aspect in the invention is the semiconductor integrated circuit of the supply voltage work by providing from power circuit, this semiconductor integrated circuit includes from original frequency, operating frequency is changed the frequency changing portion to target frequency, and ask power circuit that supply voltage is changed into the supply voltage changing section of the target voltage determined according to target frequency when operating frequency changes, it is characterized in that, frequency changing portion repeatedly carries out the change from original frequency to target frequency in a stepwise manner.

In addition, the control method of semiconductor integrated circuit according to an aspect of the present invention is the control method of the semiconductor integrated circuit of a kind of supply voltage work by providing from power circuit, this control method includes from original frequency, operating frequency is changed the frequency shift step to target frequency, and ask power circuit that supply voltage is changed into the supply voltage change step of the target voltage determined according to target frequency when operating frequency changes, it is characterized in that, frequency shift step repeatedly carries out change from original frequency to target frequency in a stepwise manner.

In addition, electronic installation according to a further aspect in the invention is to include power circuit and the electronic installation by the semiconductor integrated circuit from the supply voltage work of power circuit offer, this electronic installation is characterised by, semiconductor integrated circuit includes from original frequency, operating frequency is changed the frequency changing portion to target frequency, and ask power circuit that supply voltage is changed into the supply voltage changing section of the target voltage determined according to target frequency when operating frequency changes, supply voltage is changed into target voltage in response to the request of supply voltage changing section by power circuit, frequency changing portion repeatedly carries out the change from original frequency to target frequency in a stepwise manner.

Detailed description of the invention

Electronic installation according to an embodiment of the invention, it is characterised in that including: power circuit, by the semiconductor integrated circuit of supply voltage work provided from power circuit and the temperature sensor of temperature measuring semiconductor integrated circuit. Power circuit reduces supply voltage according to the rising of measured temperature.

In this electronic installation, when measured temperature is equal to or higher than predetermined threshold, supply voltage can be reduced predetermined reduction by power circuit.

Additionally, semiconductor integrated circuit according to an embodiment of the invention is the semiconductor integrated circuit of the supply voltage work by providing from power circuit. It is characterized in that, change the frequency changing portion to target frequency including by operating frequency from original frequency, and ask when operating frequency changes power circuit that supply voltage is changed into the supply voltage changing section of the target voltage determined according to target frequency. Frequency changing portion repeatedly carries out the change from original frequency to target frequency in a stepwise manner.

In semiconductor integrated circuit, can be determined according to original frequency and target frequency by the change number of times of the operating frequency of frequency changing portion change from original frequency to target frequency.

Additionally, in semiconductor integrated circuit, frequency changing portion can by changing the change proceeding to target frequency to the one or more intermediate frequencies determined according to original frequency and target frequency in a stepwise manner by operating frequency.

Embodiments of the invention are described in detail below according to accompanying drawing.

[configuration of electronic installation]

Fig. 1 shows the configuration figure of the illustrative circuitry configuration of the electronic installation 1 including semiconductor integrated circuit 10 according to an embodiment of the invention. Electronic installation 1 is configured to include semiconductor integrated circuit 10, temperature sensor 11, temperature controller 12, power circuit 13 and power control circuit 14.

Semiconductor integrated circuit 10 is configured as including CMOS(complementary metal oxide semiconductors (CMOS)) integrated circuit, and can be such as CPU, SOC etc. The semiconductor integrated circuit 10 supply voltage Vp work by providing from power circuit 13. Hereinafter, semiconductor integrated circuit 10 is considered as the arithmetic facility performing various information processings according to the program being stored in the memorizer of built-in memorizer or outside. Semiconductor integrated circuit 10 can operate content (being the content of the program to run here) according to it and internally change the operating frequency f of himself. When changing the operating frequency f of himself, semiconductor integrated circuit 10 output is for the instruction according to this change change supply voltage Vp to power control circuit 14.

Additionally, semiconductor integrated circuit 10 is incorporated to temperature sensor 11. The temperature of semiconductor integrated circuit 10 is measured in temperature sensor 11, and exports the signal of telecommunication indicating result to temperature controller 12.

Temperature controller 12 receives the signal exported by temperature sensor 11, and exports the expression information according to the temperature T of the semiconductor integrated circuit 10 of this semaphore request received to power control circuit 14.

Power circuit 13 is configured to include being used for example as the power supply IC etc. of switching regulator. It converts the power supply (such as, commercial AC mains or usb host device) outside electronic installation 1 or the power that is incorporated to the battery in electronic installation 1 and provides to given voltage, and provides it to the various piece in electronic installation 1.Especially, power circuit 13 supplies power to semiconductor integrated circuit 10 according to the instruction inputted from power control circuit 14 with supply voltage Vp.

Power control circuit 14 is the circuit of the work controlling power circuit 13, and is configured by pico computer etc. In the present embodiment, the power control circuit 14 instruction based on the change according to operating frequency f inputted from semiconductor integrated circuit 10 and/or the information from the temperature T representing semiconductor integrated circuit 10 of temperature controller 12 input determine supply voltage Vp, and instruction power circuit 13 supplies power to semiconductor integrated circuit 10 with this supply voltage Vp determined.

[change of operating frequency]

It follows that the control carried out when the semiconductor integrated circuit 10 of the present embodiment changes operating frequency f is illustrated.

Generally, the lower limit (making the MIN magnitude of voltage needed for semiconductor integrated circuit 10 normal operation) that should be supplied to the supply voltage Vp of semiconductor integrated circuit 10 changes according to operating frequency f. It is to say, operating frequency f is more high, it is necessary to the value of supply voltage Vp also more big. Therefore, in order to suppress the power consumption of semiconductor integrated circuit 10, it is desirable to when dynamically changing operating frequency f, supply voltage Vp also associatedly changes, before and after operating frequency f changes, the supply voltage Vp as close possible to lower limit is supplied to semiconductor integrated circuit 10. Specifically, when the operating frequency f of semiconductor integrated circuit 10 changes to target frequency f2(> f1 from original frequency f1) time, supply voltage Vp also changes to the target voltage Vp2(> Vp1 corresponding with target frequency f2 from the initial voltage Vp1 corresponding with original frequency f1). Hereinafter, semiconductor integrated circuit 10 is defined as lower voltage limit Vl at MIN voltage lower limit value necessary to target frequency f2 steady operation.

Here, if the value of target voltage Vp2 is set to no better than lower voltage limit Vl, it would be possible that situation about occur is, the electric current flow through in semiconductor integrated circuit 10 and operating frequency f change and fluctuate due to the noise that produces in semiconductor integrated circuit 10 explicitly, and supply voltage Vp declines below lower voltage limit Vl. Therefore, target voltage Vp2 is set greater than the value of lower voltage limit Vl by power control circuit 14. That is, it needs to target voltage Vp2 to be set as the Vp2=Vl+ �� value represented. Here the undulate quantity of the supply voltage Vp that the value consideration of �� causes due to noise is determined. But, if will be above the supply voltage Vp of lower voltage limit Vl to be by this way supplied to semiconductor integrated circuit 10, then the power consumption of semiconductor integrated circuit 10 can correspondingly increase.

Therefore, in the present embodiment, the semiconductor integrated circuit 10 one or more intermediate frequency fm(f1 < fm < f2 by being divided into from original frequency f1 to the change of target frequency f2) repeatedly change operating frequency f in a stepwise manner. This can reduce the voltage pulsation caused by noise. Therefore, compared with disposable carry out from original frequency f1 to the change of target frequency f2 to situation, the value of �� can reduce.

Fig. 2 A and Fig. 2 B is the figure that the Control of Voltage when operating frequency f changes in conventional example and the Control of Voltage in the present embodiment are compared. Fig. 2 A schematically shows the time change of operating frequency f and supply voltage Vp in conventional example, and Fig. 2 B schematically shows the time change of operating frequency f and supply voltage Vp in the present embodiment.In the two figure, horizontal axis representing time, time t0 represents and changes the timing to target voltage Vp2 from initial voltage Vp1. Further, the longitudinal axis represents the amplitude of supply voltage Vp and operating frequency f. As shown in Figure 2 A, if disposable carried out from original frequency f1 to the change of target frequency f2, then the fluctuation that supply voltage Vp is caused by noise after frequency shift is relatively large. Therefore, target voltage Vp2 is set to a relatively large value, such that it is able to prevent supply voltage Vp from declining below lower voltage limit Vl after experiencing this fluctuation. In contrast, as shown in Figure 2 B, it is divided into three times from original frequency f1 to the change of target frequency f2 to carry out. Specifically, operating frequency f is changed in a stepwise manner, first from original frequency f1 to first intermediate frequency fm1, then from the first intermediate frequency fm1 to second intermediate frequency fm2, then from the second intermediate frequency fm2 to target frequency f2. In this way, repeatedly changing each time, the frequency after change with change before frequency ratio compared with the situation of the disposable change of frequency relatively small. Therefore, noise the fluctuation of the supply voltage Vp caused is also little accordingly. Therefore, although target voltage Vp2 is set to the lower of the example than Fig. 2 A, but be prevented from supply voltage Vp decline under lower voltage limit Vl.

, first the first supply voltage Vp only changes once from Fig. 2 B it can be clearly seen that in the present embodiment, and after this, operating frequency f changes repeatedly. Generally, changing of supply voltage Vp needs the longer time, because this is to be realized by the power circuit 13 controlled outside semiconductor integrated circuit 10. In contrast, the time that the change of operating frequency f need not so be grown, because this is undertaken by semiconductor integrated circuit 10 therein. In the present embodiment, although the number of times that operating frequency f changes adds compared with traditional example, but the change number of times of supply voltage Vp is once, and this is the same with traditional example. Therefore, from original frequency f1 change to the time required for target frequency f2 compared with traditional example almost without different. If the time that the change of supply voltage Vp need not so be grown, then can also change in conjunction with the stepping of operating frequency f and repeatedly change supply voltage Vp in a stepwise manner.

Here, will to when changing to target frequency f2 from original frequency f1, the change of operating frequency f how many times should be divided into perform and how to determine in one or more intermediate frequency fm each illustrate.

Change number of times if carried out operating frequency f during from a certain original frequency f1 to the change of a certain target frequency f2 is defined as n times, then semiconductor integrated circuit 10 changes operating frequency f by N-1 intermediate frequency fm. In the case, intermediate frequency fm should be determined so that the noise amplitude produced owing to changing every time changes little as far as possible. Here, the noise amplitude produced owing to once changing is determined according to ratio between operating frequency f before and after changing. Therefore, if operating frequency f takes turns by n-th changes the natural number that intermediate frequency fm(n is 1 to N-1 being set to) it is expressed as fm(n), then intermediate frequency fm(n ideally) obtained by expression formula calculated below.

[expression formula 1]

fm(n)=f1·(f2f1)nN

According to this calculation expression, the operating frequency f of semiconductor integrated circuit 10 from original frequency f1, and by (N-1) individual intermediate frequency fm(n) increase to target frequency f2 with geometrical progression.Often there is restriction in the value of the operating frequency f that can change in practice for semiconductor integrated circuit 10. But, now it is set as the value close to the value obtained by above-mentioned calculation expression among the multiple operating frequency f that can change.

As intermediate frequency fm(n) when determining, it should it is set as that the value of target voltage Vp2 is determined also according to this. According to above-mentioned calculation expression, when changing each time, operating frequency f increases to (f2/f1) of the frequency before change(1/N)Frequency again. The manufacturer of electronic installation 1 can by such as using the method etc. of sampling device measurement to obtain the information producing how many voltage drops with this change of operating frequency f about being associated in advance. Then, target voltage Vp2 can the value of �� be determined by using this information to determine.

Further, how many times should be divided into from original frequency f1 to carry out to the change of target frequency f2 can according to identified below. Fig. 3 be illustrate operating frequency f from original frequency f1 change to target frequency f2 time change times N, relation time R and target voltage Vp2 needed for this change curve chart. As shown in this figure, along with the increase changing times N, operating frequency f changes required total time R and too increases. Meanwhile, increase change times N and can reduce the change width of operating frequency f each time, such that it is able to correspondingly reduce target voltage Vp2. But, as, from figure it should be understood that when changing times N more than certain level, increased further even if changing times N, the rate of descent of target voltage Vp2 also becomes to be not as high. What therefore, change times N to need based on wanting what degree target voltage Vp2 is suppressed to and wants to determine changing the required time R balance being restricted between scope. In the example of fig. 3, it is shown that change the curve of relation between times N and required time R and illustrate that changing the curve of relation between times N and target voltage Vp2 is equal near 3 at change number of times and intersects. Therefore, if it is desired to balance shorter required time R and relatively low target voltage Vp2, then change times N and be set as 3. Alternatively, it is possible to adopt another more to emphasize the change number of times of required time R or target voltage Vp2.

Should be set as that the value of target voltage Vp2 and intermediate frequency fm needs to determine for each combination of original frequency f1 and target frequency f2. These values can be previously recorded among semiconductor integrated circuit 10 when electronic installation 1 is freighted by factory. When operating frequency f changes to certain target frequency f2 from certain original frequency f1, the value of the target voltage Vp2 that this combination with original frequency f1 and target frequency f2 of record associates is exported power control circuit 14 by semiconductor integrated circuit 10, thus asking power circuit 13 to provide power with this target voltage Vp2. After this, semiconductor integrated circuit 10 is operated the change n times of frequency f by operating frequency f in the way of (N-1) individual intermediate frequency fm that this combination with original frequency f1 and target frequency f2 of overwriting associates. This noise that can suppress to change with operating frequency f and produce, and target voltage Vp2 is set to low.

Thus much, particularly the control performing to increase in the situation of the change of operating frequency f is illustrated. At reduction supply voltage Vp with in suppressing power consumption, as above-mentioned in carrying out the situation of change of reduction operating frequency f, operating frequency f is not necessarily required to change repeatedly.But, in semiconductor integrated circuit 10, not only lower voltage limit Vl, and also upper voltage limit Vu is also set generally according to operating frequency f. In the case, in order to make semiconductor integrated circuit 10 normal operation, it is necessary to avoid being applied above the voltage of this upper voltage limit Vu. But, if the disposable change of operating frequency f is bigger, then due to the noise occurred that is associated with the change of operating frequency f, it is possible to there will be supply voltage Vp and temporarily exceed upper voltage limit Vu. If upper voltage limit Vu is depending on the value of the change of operating frequency f, then in performing the situation of change of reduction operating frequency f, the supply voltage Vp after change also will exceed upper voltage limit Vu. Therefore, semiconductor integrated circuit 10 can also repeatedly proceed to the change of target frequency f2 in performing the situation of change of reduction operating frequency f. In this case, change times N and intermediate frequency fm to be similar to the situation of above-mentioned increase operating frequency f and determine. Additionally, the target voltage Vp2 after changing is set to the value of the low value being at least contemplated to the fluctuation caused due to noise than upper voltage limit Vu.

Although the supply voltage Vp that power control circuit 14 controls in superincumbent explanation power circuit 13 is illustrated, but semiconductor integrated circuit 10 can also directly control the supply voltage Vp of power circuit 13. Additionally, temperature sensor 11 and temperature controller 12 not always control to be required only for the change carrying out above-mentioned operating frequency f.

[Control of Voltage according to temperature]

Power control circuit 14 temperature change of semiconductor integrated circuit 10 measured by temperature sensor 11 can change the supply voltage Vp being supplied to semiconductor integrated circuit 10 by power circuit 13. Especially, in the present embodiment, perform to reduce the control of supply voltage Vp according to rising of semiconductor integrated circuit 10 temperature. This will be described below.

The characteristic of the CMOS used in based semiconductor integrated circuit 10, the lower voltage limit Vl corresponding with above-mentioned operating frequency f depends on that temperature T changes. Fig. 4 is the curve chart schematically showing the relation between this lower voltage limit Vl and temperature T. Dotted line represents the characteristic of the grid length traditional cmos more than 65 nanometers, and solid line represents that grid length equals to or less than the characteristic of the CMOS in recent years of 65 nanometers. Specifically, in CMOS, mobility and threshold voltage (parameter as determining its performance) have temperature dependency. For mobility, performance can uprise along with temperature and worsen. For threshold voltage, performance can uprise along with temperature and strengthen. In the grid length traditional cmos more than 65 nanometers, the impact of mobility is occupied an leading position, and therefore there is the tendency of penalty when the temperature is high. That is, in the semiconductor integrated circuit including this CMOS, as shown in phantom in figure 4, when lower voltage limit Vl is relatively low higher than temperature when temperature is higher, even if semiconductor integrated circuit is operated in identical operating frequency. Therefore, when the semiconductor integrated circuit including this CMOS uses in high temperature environments, it is necessary to make it pass through relatively high supply voltage Vp work. But, recent years, along with the microminiaturization of CMOS, the dependency of temperature is also presented the tendency different from the past by CMOS performance. Specifically, equaling to or less than in the CMOS of 65 nanometers at the grid length occurred recent years, when the temperature is high, the impact of threshold voltage becomes dominating, and presents the tendency of performance enhancement when the temperature is high. Therefore, including the semiconductor integrated circuit of this CMOS with shorter grid length, there is lower voltage limit Vl and uprise and the tendency of step-down along with temperature, as shown by the bold lines in fig.

Therefore, the temperature rising being assumed to according to semiconductor integrated circuit 10 according to the electronic installation 1 of the present embodiment reduces the supply voltage Vp being supplied to semiconductor integrated circuit 10. Specifically, for instance, when the temperature T of the semiconductor integrated circuit 10 of the information instruction exported by temperature controller 12 becomes equal to or higher than predetermined threshold Tth, supply voltage Vp is reduced predetermined reduction �� by power control circuit 14 instruction power circuit 13. �� value in this case is previously recorded in power control circuit 14. Additionally, when temperature T becomes less than predetermined threshold value Tth, supply voltage Vp is returned to the value before reduction (that is, supply voltage Vp being increased ��) by power control circuit 14.

Fig. 5 is the curve chart that power consumption when carrying out such control and do not carry out such control is compared. Transverse axis represents temperature T, and the longitudinal axis represents power P. Further, solid line illustrates the situation controlled that changes of the supply voltage Vp that being not carried out rises is associated with temperature, and shown in phantom execution changes the situation controlled. In the example of this figure, when temperature becomes equal to or higher than threshold value Tth, power circuit 13 is assumed to and supply voltage Vp is reduced 0.5V, then, as a result, the power consumption of semiconductor integrated circuit 10 is greatly inhibited in the temperature T region equal to or higher than threshold value Tth.

Although the quantity only one of which of the threshold value Tth of example in Fig. 5 but it also may set multiple threshold value Tth. Such as, in the every 20 degree situations setting threshold value Tth, whenever the temperature rising 20 degree of semiconductor integrated circuit 10, power control circuit 14 reduces supply voltage Vp all in a stepwise manner. In this case, the minimizing amount �� of supply voltage Vp can be each the corresponding multiple value in different from each other and multiple threshold value Tth. Even if this allows when lower voltage limit Vl changes in response to the rising of temperature T is non-linear, supply voltage Vp still is able to change to the optimum being associated with the rising of temperature T.

Additionally, desirably, the value �� that supply voltage Vp reduces is set as having certain allowance. Such as, if threshold value Tth is 50 DEG C, then when temperature T becomes equal to or is higher than 50 DEG C, power control circuit 14 changes supply voltage Vp so that can at least become lower voltage limit Vl when the temperature of semiconductor integrated circuit 10 is spent for (50-��). The value of this �� is determined according to the measurement error of such as temperature sensor 11. Even if this allows power circuit 13 also to be able to provide semiconductor integrated circuit 10 to work necessary voltage when temperature sensor 11 exists measurement error etc. Additionally, when detecting that temperature T becomes equal to or is higher than threshold value Tth, power control circuit 14 can change supply voltage Vp after waiting for the predetermined time, rather than changes supply voltage Vp immediately. Alternatively, power control circuit 14 can change supply voltage Vp in the timing determined according to the duty of semiconductor integrated circuit 10. Specifically, it is possible to adopt following mode. Specifically, when the processing load of semiconductor integrated circuit 10 is less than predetermined value, temperature T tends to not rise so much. Therefore, even if when temperature T becomes equal to or is higher than threshold value Tth, power control circuit 14 also can reduce supply voltage Vp again after the temperature T state equal to or higher than threshold value Tth continues the time at least one predetermined, rather than reduces supply voltage Vp immediately. If on the contrary, become equal at temperature T or be higher than the timing of threshold value Tth, the processing load of semiconductor integrated circuit 10 equals to or more than predetermined value, then power control circuit 14 reduces supply voltage Vp immediately.

Although to temperature sensor 11, the situation being merged among semiconductor integrated circuit 10 self is illustrated in superincumbent description, but temperature sensor 11 can also outside being arranged on semiconductor integrated circuit 10. In this case, the certainty of measurement of temperature T is lower than the certainty of measurement when temperature sensor 11 is arranged on semiconductor integrated circuit 10 inside. But, if the actual temperature of the measurement result of pre research temperature sensor 11 and semiconductor integrated circuit 10, and threshold value Tth and minimizing amount �� is determined according to result, then temperature sensor 11 can be similar to it is arranged on situation realization semiconductor integrated circuit 10 within according to the control reducing supply voltage Vp that rises of the temperature of semiconductor integrated circuit 10.

Additionally, in the foregoing description, the explanation that temperature controller 12 is carried out is directly output about the information of temperature T to power control circuit 14. However, it is possible to replace this way, temperature controller 12 can export the information about temperature T to semiconductor integrated circuit 10. In this case, semiconductor integrated circuit 10 self determines whether temperature T becomes equal to or higher than threshold value Tth and according to determining that result changes the request of supply voltage Vp to power control circuit 14 output.

Control when the change of operating frequency f described above and can independently carry out or be combined with each other carrying out to the control of supply voltage Vp according to temperature. In the situation being combined with each other, when operating frequency f changes, the supply voltage Vp after change can by deducting according to determining at the temperature T of the relevant timing minimizing amount �� determined from according to the target voltage Vp2 determined of the target frequency f2 after changing.
